metaBuilds.synergy: Dawnstar pairs with Adele's melee autos to weaken whoever she sticks to, Xenia shields the carry she peels for, and Raiment of Renewal keeps her standing through Queen’s Garden fights.

items.Dawnstar: First: melee autos after Imperial Lash stack its damage-dealt reduction on the diver.
items.Xenia: Second: shields the ally Adele is guarding while Iron Rose shields herself.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Third: missing-health regen refills her between Royal Flourish engages.

metaBuilds.holes: Little damage of its own, so if Adele can't land Imperial Lash she just soaks without threatening anyone.

metaBuilds.holes: All three are armor-leaning, so a mage-heavy enemy team melts her despite Vanguardian.

metaBuilds.synergy: Same Dawnstar into Xenia frontline, but Tainted Guard punishes attackers who hit Adele while Iron Rose makes her a big target.

metaBuilds.holes: Tainted Guard only works if enemies actually hit Adele; a backline poke team ignores her.
